data.content_ref: inline:The claimed dependence is refuted only if the uniform installation order produces the same 3-of-26 distribution, but this test is logically inadequate to establish the mechanism. A uniform policy-driven order could produce identical failure rates while still being ad-hoc in its initial selection criteria; conversely, the original 'one-author ritual' might be refuted by a different distribution while still being ad-hoc. The proposed refutation condition fails to isolate the specific causal variable—whether order matters at all versus whether the ordering rationale is systematic—leaving the dependence claim untested by its own criterion.
